suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as complication outcome risk. Require Buerger disease/TAO and documented amputation or loss-of-use outcome; preserve ongoing tobacco exposure, ischemic severity and treatment history. Amputation is an outcome risk, not inevitable; the systematic review is treatment/outcome focused. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Thromboangiitis Obliterans (Buerger's Disease) and Amputation / Loss of Use of Limbs or Digits
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
